Name: Game Room - Lunar Lander
Description: The 1979 Atari original, brought to Game Room: land the module gently, on limited fuel, against the moon's gravity.

Achievements.Name: Velocity Gamer
Achievements.Description: Travel at over 35 mph (55 km/h) while playing a game

Achievements.Name: Keep It Moving
Achievements.Description: Travel 2/3 mile (1 km) while playing a single play session of the game

Achievements.Name: Retro Roadie
Achievements.Description: Travel an accumulated distance of 6 miles (10 km) while playing the game

Achievements.Name: Try Try Again
Achievements.Description: Surpass your own leaderboard score 3 times

Achievements.Name: Across The Board
Achievements.Description: Win a medal of each type

Achievements.Name: Full Moon
Achievements.Description: Play a game during a full moon
